questions.q: Sulphur is listed as complementary to which remedy for rectal complaints and diarrhoea?
questions.why: Boericke: Aloe – complementary Sulphur; and Sulphur's complementaries include Aloe and Psorinum.

questions.q: A headache that is relieved by the passing of a profuse quantity of urine is characteristic of:
questions.why: Gelsemium: headache relieved by profuse urination (Allen's Keynotes, Boericke).

questions.q: Which statement about diabetes is FALSE (GPSC Medical Officer, 2025)?
opts: Acromegaly and Cushing's syndrome can cause diabetes
Most type 2 diabetics die of cardiovascular disease
Type 2 diabetics are more prone to ketoacidosis than type 1
Fasting glucose above 126 mg/dL establishes diabetes
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Type 1 diabetes is the ketosis-prone form.

questions.q: Indifference towards those he loves best, with a buoyant feeling and an increased ability to exert himself without fatigue, suggests:
questions.why: Fluoric acid (Boericke): indifference towards those loved best; increased ability to exercise mentally and physically without fatigue.

questions.q: The police inquest, formerly under CrPC section 174, is now covered by:
questions.why: BNSS 194 replaces CrPC 174 (police inquest); BNSS 196 replaces CrPC 176 (magistrate inquest).

questions.q: In Boenninghausen's seven-point scheme (Quis, Quid, Ubi, Quibus auxiliis, Cur, Quomodo, Quando), 'Quibus auxiliis' refers to:
questions.why: Quibus auxiliis ('with what help') means the concomitants; Cur is the cause, Quando the time and Ubi the seat.

questions.q: Mallory-Denk bodies (Mallory hyaline) in hepatocytes are most characteristic of:
questions.why: Mallory hyaline consists of damaged intermediate (keratin) filaments and is a hallmark of alcoholic hepatitis; apoptotic Councilman bodies occur in viral hepatitis.

questions.q: Jaundice with an enlarged, tender liver, clay-coloured stools and a tendency to gallstones, for which the mother tincture is often used, calls for:
questions.why: Chionanthus is a liver remedy for jaundice, hepatic enlargement, clay-coloured stools and gallstone colic.

questions.q: Beyond about which centesimal potency is it unlikely that even one molecule of the original substance remains?
questions.why: At 12C the dilution is 10 to the power -24, beyond Avogadro's number (about 6 x 10 to the power 23).

questions.q: A whitish membrane on the tonsils that bleeds when scraped off suggests (GPSC Medical Officer, 2025):
questions.why: Topic 9, Surgery, ENT, Eye and First Aid. The diphtheria pseudomembrane is adherent and bleeds on removal.
